title: shared_variable_update
description:
JSON payload of the `shared_variable_update` topic, found in `data.json_string.data` of the `urinterfaces/msg/VariableUpdate` message.

The message contains all shared (application) variables. It is published periodically, at most every 500 ms.

update_type.description: Always `full`: every message contains all shared variables.

shared_variables.description: All shared (application) variables as `name: value` pairs.
